title: Admitting a Mistake to a Client
paragraphs: After discovering that his team had sent a client the wrong pricing information, Bilal faced a difficult choice: quietly correct it later or immediately admit the mistake and risk the client's frustration.

He chose to call the client directly that same afternoon, explaining exactly what had gone wrong and outlining precisely how they would fix it, rather than waiting to see if the mistake would simply be overlooked.

The client, initially annoyed, appreciated that Bilal had not tried to hide the error or shift blame onto someone else on his team, which was something she had experienced with other companies before.
Six months later, that same client renewed her contract, telling Bilal directly that his honesty during the mistake had earned more trust than a flawless service record ever could have.
